summary: autotel-terminal 32.0.0: static patterns match on base64 decode and POST/ping co-occurrence in bundled CLI
details: The package ships a bundled CLI (dist/cli.cjs and dist/cli.js) in which base64 decoding (Buffer.from(..., "base64").toString(...)) co-occurs with multiple POST calls and a ping command in the same minified file. Deeper tracing of the CLI's execution paths did not complete, so the specific destinations of the POST calls, the data being sent, and whether any of this fires at install or import time versus only on explicit CLI invocation are not established. package.json lifecycle hooks and the reachability of the flagged code from module top-level or lifecycle scripts are not confirmed from the available evidence. The observed keyword co-occurrence pattern is consistent with a range of behaviors including legitimate CLI HTTP clients, telemetry, and exfiltration, and cannot on its own distinguish among them.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
